evals.prompt: Our B2B software company has 3 sales reps and revenue has been flat for two quarters. Leads come in through the website into HubSpot. Where are we losing sales?
evals.expected_output: Should check for product-marketing.md first. Should identify the pipeline model and ask for or read the HubSpot data. Should baseline the eight metrics (at minimum response time, orphaned leads, data completeness, selling-time share, forecast error). Should run the pipeline defect catalogue with thresholds (median response > 60 min, orphaned leads > 5%, incomplete records > 25%). Should rank findings by annual cost with an explicit confidence label, name the smallest fix per defect (often a HubSpot workflow, not a new tool), and include a 'not found / not tested' section.
assertions: Applies the pipeline defect catalogue with thresholds
Ranks defects by annual cost with confidence labels
Names a smallest fix and proof metric per defect

evals.prompt: We run 15 grocery branches on an ERP. Sales are down in two branches and the buyer says the reports look fine. Audit the sales process.
evals.expected_output: Should switch to the retail / POS defect catalogue. Should insist on per-branch rates rather than chain averages. Should test stockouts with demand, negative stock and unposted receipts, cost or price integrity (cost = 0), replenishment lag, branch deviation (±40%), and silent automation (reports nobody acts on). Should separate data causes from process causes. Should compute stockout cost as daily rate × margin × days out and rank the two branches' findings by money.
assertions: Uses the retail / POS defect catalogue
Tests stockouts, negative stock, cost/price integrity and replenishment lag
Checks whether existing reports have an owner and a closed-loop action
Separates data causes from process causes
Estimates cost with stated arithmetic and confidence

evals.prompt: Just tell me what to automate in our sales team first. We have Zoho CRM and 8 reps.
evals.expected_output: Should refuse to pick an automation before a baseline exists: should ask for or estimate the eight metrics, run the catalogue, and rank by money. Should explain that automating an undefined step makes a bad process faster. Should then map the top defect to the smallest automation, preferring a rule inside Zoho over a new platform for a team this size, and point to sales-automation-selection for platform choice.
assertions: Does not recommend automation before a baseline
Ranks by money rather than by the loudest complaint
Prefers a rule in the existing CRM for a small team
